documents.title: Trump announces Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire, both sides agree
documents.lead: President Trump announced an immediate energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine. Trump said both sides agreed to stop attacks on each other's energy facilities.

documents.title: Trump announced a partial Russia-Ukraine ceasefire. Did either country know about it?
documents.lead: President Trump announced an energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine on Sunday. Neither Moscow nor Kyiv confirmed the agreement, and a White House official said the initial focus was oil refineries, with power plants possibly added later.
